identification_key: Lobby portraits carry no names; cookies are named by element icon + art, cross-checked against the author's text and the round brief. Light: 브시커 = brown hair, purple eye, pink hat; 치케 = gold/yellow hair (blue card frame); 우유 = white nurse with purple banner and pink bear; 실론 = white-bearded old knight. Water: 피겨 = gold face with purple headphones; 메소 = green hair, goggles. Grass: 샤르도네 = pale lilac/pink hair with green streaks; 정전 = teal hair, orange flower. Dark: 석류 = red curly hair; 피노 = grey hair, monocle; 닼초 = black/red hair. Fire: 전갈 = red hair. 딸크 (Strawberry Crepe) = light, pink fluffy hair (83515, by elimination: the author says he put 딸크 in the Cherry slot and it is the only non-standard cookie). Stars: each card shows five star slots; gold stars only = 1–5★, and each pink star over a gold one adds one, so N pink stars = 5+N★ (10★ = all pink). Star counts below are read that way from 2x crops; where pink/gold was ambiguous the value carries a '?'. Pets: 핫도그 = bun with sauce, 와사비문어 = green, 색동주머니 = white round with red/green trim; the number on the pet tile is transcribed as written (★N), as in the previous round.

posts.title_en: Macaron plus Chardonnay: does crit stack?
posts.summary_en: Running Macaron and Chardonnay together doesn't stack: of the same buff only the highest value applies. Commenters explain Cheesecake + Milk works differently: Cheesecake's ATK buff raises Milk's ATK, which raises Milk's own ATK buff; Milk only partly takes her own buff (3 of 10 stacks), so Cheesecake's buff is the bigger lift for her.
mechanics: Same-type buffs don't stack; only the highest applies (so Macaron + Chardonnay crit buffs don't add).
Milk receives only 3 of her own 10 ATK-buff stacks; Cheesecake's ATK buff exceeds that, raising Milk's ATK and with it the buff Milk gives others.

posts.title_en: Is crit rate pointless in conquest?
posts.summary_en: Screenshot compares two Eternal 환상을 여는 꿈빛지팡이 plates in a '토벌' preset: Lv.97 (crit 34.03% main; 스증 8.53%, 치피 14.23%; 209.79M) vs Lv.106 (crit 39.77%; 치확 16.76%, 스증 8.62%; 232.96M). Replies: conquest receives every growth source so crit rate's value drops and crit damage is better; another says the boss has no crit resistance, which is why crit-res substats get swapped for 피감/체력.

gear.why: commenter: crit rate's value falls in conquest

mechanics: Claim: the conquest boss has no crit resistance.
Claim: conquest applies every growth source (돌파력, research, honor, Stellar), lowering crit rate's marginal value.

quotes.kr: 토벌은 모든 성장요소(돌파력, 연구소, 명예, 스텔라 등)을 다 받아서 치확 밸류가 떨어지는 걸로 알고 있음 그래서 치피가 더 좋다고
quotes.en: Conquest receives every growth source (breakthrough, lab, honor, Stellar…), so crit rate is worth less; that's why crit damage is better

quotes.kr: 보스가 치저가 없다고 한거 같음 그래서 부옵 치저도 다빼버리고 피감체증 이렇게 가잖아요

disagreements: Poster: crit res is pointless now. Commenters: it matters more in a crit-rate meta.

posts.title_en: Why doesn't Skating Queen get Pomegranate's buff?
posts.summary_en: Stage-mode screenshot (stage 219-25, all cookies Lv.110): Pomegranate's straw goes to 이온 instead of Skating Queen. Answers: Skating Queen runs out of Milk's range, loses the ATK buff and falls below 이온 in ATK, so she loses the straw; group them by kiting back and forth.
rng: Skating Queen leaving Milk's buff range drops her ATK and can lose her the straw.
mechanics: Straw goes to the highest ATK; Milk's buff only reaches cookies in range, so a roaming Skating Queen can fall below others.

quotes.kr: 공격력 높은순으로 빨대 받는거라 우유버프를 이온이 받고 피겨가 못받으면 피겨 공격력이 이온보다 낮아져서 빨대도 못받는거임
quotes.en: The straw goes by highest ATK; if 이온 gets Milk's buff and Skating Queen doesn't, her ATK drops below 이온's and she loses the straw

posts.title_en: Does this really scale with skill amp?

mechanics: Debuffs roll focus vs resist only; damage rolls accuracy vs evasion only; Scorpion's DoT stacks can still miss (commenter).

quotes.kr: 디버프는 집중 저항만 보고 딜 들어가는 건 명중 회피만 본다 ㅇㅇ 전갈 도트뎀도 그래서 중첩은 쌓여도 미스나기도 함

posts.summary_en: Levelling fillers raises their ATK; can they steal Pomegranate's straw mid-fight? They need at least Lv.60–70 not to die. Answers: if one steals it, retry. 언담: a 1-point ATK edge usually wins the straw, but the closer the ATK values the more often it gets stolen; many tries fix it.
rng: Close ATK values make the straw flip between cookies; the higher-ATK one 'usually' wins (언담).
mechanics: Fillers need about Lv.60–70 to survive (author).
Straw goes to higher ATK even by 1 point 'mostly'; near-equal ATK gives a chance to lose it.

quotes.en: They need at least Lv.60–70 not to die

quotes.kr: 공격력이 1이라도 차이나면 웬만하면 공높은쪽이 먹음. 근데 공격력이 비슷할수록 뺏길확률이 생기는거임. 트라이많이하면 해결됨
